messages:
Cass: quick UX note from customer call: when you open the relevance inspector in compact preview it hides the metadata column and some users expected the CSV export to follow what they saw, not the full dataset. Confusing. Arjun: that's because export currently uses the canonical column order, not the active view. we can change to export-by-view (exclude hidden cols) but must make it explicit in modal. Maya: product POV: exporting exactly what you see is more intuitive. add a checkbox "Export visible columns only" defaulted ON when user has hidden columns. Riley: accessibility/implementation: if we change export behavior, update the label and aria-describedby to explain what "visible" means. screen reader users need clarity. June: small a11y nit in inspector: NVDA reads the inspector title after the row content when opened, which is confusing. focus should move into the inspector header first. Ben: also noticed keyboard users can't open the row context menu with Enter when a row is focused; we only listen for Space. add Enter handler. Cass: copy for the export checkbox: "Export only visible columns (recommended)" and a tooltip: "Exports the columns currently shown in the preview. Uncheck to export full dataset including hidden fields" Arjun: I'll implement export-by-view and add a small banner in the modal when hidden columns exist: "Some columns are hidden in the preview. Choose to export only visible columns." Maya: about compact rows: QA flagged that compact + virtual scroll causes focus loss when you arrow down quickly. Seems like virtualization unmounts the focused node. We should pin focused item before changing the window. Riley: implementation tip: when moving focus to a virtualized row, call scrollIntoView({block: 'nearest'}) before focus() to ensure it's mounted. Also debounce rapid arrow events to avoid churn. June: aria suggestion for relevance labels: use aria-labelledby pointing to a hidden label that reads "Relevance score: X" rather than separate sr-only + visual duplicate. keeps DOM clean. Ben: code sketch for live selection announcer (debounced): 
<div id=\"select-announcer\" class=\"sr-only\" aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\"></div>
// update after 200ms debounce
document.getElementById('select-announcer').textContent = `${count} items selected`;
Cass: also: dark theme contrast for the score pill is low on small sizes. design should pick a token that meets 4.5:1 or add a 1px border and increase text weight. Maya: will add two color tokens in Figma and a note: "Use stronger token for small text in pill". Arjun: one more: when the inspector is open and user toggles dense rows shortcut (D) the layout height changes and inspector overlaps content. maybe disable density toggle while inspector is open or animate height so it doesn't occlude controls. Riley: prefer animating and ensuring inspector repositions with a smooth transition. instant layout jumps feel jarring for keyboard users. June: test plan: Arjun + Ben will land a PR for export-by-view + Enter key on context menu this sprint. Riley will add the scrollIntoView focus fix + debounce. Maya will update Figma with color tokens + export checkbox copy. I'll coordinate a quick screen-reader sanity check on staging after PRs land. Cass: ping me when staging is ready, I'll ask the support rep who reported to retest. Thanks all! :slightly_smiling_face:
